correctness.rationale: Every admissible base-prime support either meets both parities or occupies a single parity. In mixed parity, a digitwise multiple of p+1 makes the gcd valuation zero unless exactly two unit digits exhaust N. Single parity yields an explicit exactly-one-borrow multiplier. In the two-unit case, Kummer plus bounded alternating digit sums precludes one carry and explicit witnesses attain precisely two. Finite exact checks independently support the derivation.
